title: Monkey holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonShine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8ab5'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8214f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a80f34'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='monkeyFur' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b9773f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a4f22'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='monkeyFace' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f6cf9c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d9a468'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 30 L52 40 L50 50' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='13' ry='16' fill='url(#balloonShine)'/>
  <path d='M50 36 L47 40 L53 40 Z' fill='#b8143a'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='15' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffc0d2' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- monkey body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='19' fill='url(#monkeyFur)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='11' ry='13' fill='url(#monkeyFace)'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a4f22'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#d9a468'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#d9a468'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M36 62 Q28 58 26 50' stroke='#8a4f22' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q72 56 68 46' stroke='#8a4f22' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='49' r='4.5' fill='#d9a468'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='45' r='4.5' fill='#d9a468'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='17' fill='url(#monkeyFur)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='40' r='6' fill='#8a4f22'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='40' r='6' fill='#8a4f22'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#d9a468'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#d9a468'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='13' ry='12' fill='url(#monkeyFace)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#fbe0bd'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='42.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='42.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='51' r='1' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='51' r='1' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 55 Q50 60 56 55' stroke='#8a5a2a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
